sections.label: Eyes
sections.text:
Feel irritable; child bores into them with
fists.

sections.label: Respiratory
sections.text:
Fluent coryza; margins of nostrils
feel sore. Sneezing; throat irritated; short, dry cough;
must take a deep breath. Dyspnoea and stitches in
chest, and painful contraction of abdominal muscles.
l^iolent, furious, exhausting cough, with much mucus;
profuse, salty, slimy expectoration, and with involun-
tary spurting of urine and sneezing. Child rubs face
7rith fist during cough, [Caust.; Puls,] Cough pro-
voked by taking a deep breath or cold drinks, from ex-
ertion, change from warm to cold air. Cough of
measles. Frequent calls to urinate at night, passing
large quantities. [Phos, ac,] Sneezing with coughing.

sections.label: Heart
sections.text:
A cardiac stimulant affecting the peri-
pheral vessels and coronary arteries.

sections.label: Urinary
sections.text:
Great urging; much zvatcry urine. In-
voluntary when coughing.

sections.label: Skin
sections.text:
Small, red spots over body, with prickling
pain.

sections.label: Extremities
sections.text:
Icy cold hands and feet, with warmth
of the rest of the body. [Menyanthes,] Tender feet
with shop girls.

sections.label: Relationship
sections.text:

can,; Bry,; Kali carh.
